## Archil caveats

<a id="archil-lifecycle"></a>

### Sandbox lifecycle

One sandbox from the OCI image `node:24-bookworm` with a 900-second session budget; Archil expiry pauses rather than deletes, so destroy stops the sandbox and waits until Archil no longer returns it.

<a id="archil-suspension"></a>

### Native sandbox suspend/resume

Archil pause keeps memory and processes; resume continues them. With `Preserve.FILESYSTEM` it stops instead and resume cold-boots.

<a id="archil-previewProtected"></a>

### Protected HTTP preview

Per-port token sent as the `X-Archil-Token` header.

<a id="archil-previewPublic"></a>

### Public HTTP preview

Ports exposed without a token when `preview.access` is `public`.

<a id="archil-termination"></a>

### Local-handle process termination

SIGTERM and SIGKILL to the process.

<a id="archil-renewal"></a>

### Configured lifetime renewal

Sets the current powered-on session's budget, 60 seconds to 24 hours.

<a id="archil-reopening"></a>

### Scoped sandbox reopening

References hold the sandbox id and the account/region scope, never the key.

<a id="archil-execution"></a>

### Execution and captured output

Argv and shell over Archil's process connection, with separate stdout and stderr; output bounded to 1 MiB.

<a id="archil-streaming"></a>

### Process streams and terminals

Sustained byte streams, terminals and incremental stdin over the process connection.

<a id="archil-finiteStdin"></a>

### Finite execution input

Exact bytes followed by EOF over the process connection.

<a id="archil-files"></a>

### Binary files and overwrite

Reads, overwrites and exclusive-create writes over the process connection.

<a id="archil-directories"></a>

### Directory primitives

Copy, move, mkdir, remove, stat, exists and listings through guest helpers.

<a id="archil-oci"></a>

### OCI image builds

Any amd64 OCI image, plus `beachside image build` for prepared image ids.

<a id="archil-network"></a>

### Measured network controls

`blocked`, `internet` and allowlists need a paid plan; the Free plan uses `archil-managed`, Archil's managed allowlist.

<a id="archil-storageComposition"></a>

### Cold snapshot with selected storage

Not implemented by this adapter.

<a id="archil-snapshots"></a>

### Snapshot roundtrip

Capture forks the source into a retained, paused holder sandbox; restore forks the holder, so `restore()` needs `requireIndependentLifecycle: false`. Checked live by hand; the shared roundtrip requires independent restores and does not apply.

<a id="archil-volumes"></a>

### Volume CRUD

Archil disks; create, inspect, list and explicit delete.

<a id="archil-persistence"></a>

### Mounted persistence

Disks mounted into sandboxes at create, read-write or read-only.

## Updating support

Reviewed summaries belong in one results JSON per provider. Generate with provider-qualification/render.ts --profile <profile> --results <results-directory> --output <output-directory>; use --check for drift. Live runs require separate authorization and durable owned cleanup.
